{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify: now we should have 800 rows
print(f"After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} rows")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df_dedup['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check severity distribution on deduplicated data
severity_counts = df_dedup['severity'].value_counts().sort_index()
print(f"Severity distribution after deduplication:\n{severity_counts}")

# Compute fraction with severe baseline disease
fraction_severe = severity_counts['severe'] / len(df_dedup)
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline disease: {fraction_severe}")"}
